拜占庭弹性法学硕士-代理协作的分层认证语义承诺Hierarchical Certified Semantic Commitment for Byzantine-Resilient LLM-Agent Collaboration

Haoran Xu 2614067X@student.gla.ac.uk 0009-0000-6659-2043 University of GlasgowGlasgowUnited Kingdom , Lei Zhang lei.zhang@glasgow.ac.uk 0000-0002-4767-3849 University of GlasgowGlasgowUnited Kingdom , Iadh Ounis Iadh.Ounis@glasgow.ac.uk 0000-0003-4701-3223 University of GlasgowGlasgowUnited Kingdom and Xianbin Wang xianbin.wang@uwo.ca 0000-0003-4890-0748 University of Western OntarioLondonCanada
摘要。Abstract.

大语言模型代理之间的拜占庭协作 需要一个最终控制原语：给定一组交付的 随机的、结构化的自然语言提案，协议 必须决定该轮是否支持提交，什么样的 提交，或键入的安全中止。天真的聚合隐藏了这一点 单一判决背后的选择；古典拜占庭断层 宽容将其隐藏在LLM提案所做的字节身份后面 不满足。我们介绍Byzantine collaboration among large-language-model agents requires a finality-control primitive: given a delivered set of stochastic, structured natural-language proposals, the protocol must decide whether the round supports a commit, what kind of commit, or a typed safe abort. Naive aggregation hides this choice behind a single verdict; classical Byzantine fault tolerance hides it behind byte-identity that LLM proposals do not satisfy. We introduce层次认证语义 承诺Hierarchical Certified Semantic Commitment(H-CSC)，一种受 BFT 启发的协议，可将 嵌入派生的最终信号优于判决条件信号 将提案分组为三种类型的结果之一：(H-CSC), a BFT-inspired protocol that converts embedding-derived finality signals over verdict-conditioned proposal groups into one of three typed outcomes: a语义提交semantic_commit (a 2​f+12f{+}1判决内语义核心 支持判决，协议发出参数绑定 对量化聚合进行消化），within-verdict semantic core backs the verdict, and the protocol emits a parameter-bound digest over the quantised aggregate), a判决提交verdict_commit（判决有很大的余地，但判决内 语义原理是分散的，并且协议发出 判决级证书，无需声明语义 聚合），或显式(the verdict has a strong margin but the within-verdict semantic rationale is dispersed, and the protocol emits a verdict-level certificate without claiming a semantic aggregate), or an explicit中止abort并输入原因。with a typed reason.贡献是类型化的最终性，而不是原始提交 准确性。The contribution is typed finality, not raw commit accuracy.我们根据两个互补的基准评估 H-CSC。上一个We evaluate H-CSC on two complementary benchmarks. On a受控的controlled语义中毒诊断（BCS_v1，semantic-poisoning diagnostic (BCS_v1,120120剧集），H-CSC 实施以低角度进行承诺 BFT 可行桶上的偏差 （episodes), the H-CSC implementation commits with low angular deviation on the BFT-feasible buckets (0.31∘0.31^{\circ}–2.04∘2.04^{\circ}，四分之三的副学位 水桶；上限是非拜占庭诊断层）， 验证受控语义分离分支。开 超越 BFT 诊断桶（, sub-degree on three of four buckets; the upper bound is a no-Byzantine diagnostic floor), validating the controlled semantic-separation branch. 1. 简介Introduction

基于大语言模型（LLM）构建的多代理系统 越来越多地用于协议输出为Multi-agent systems built on large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for tasks where the output of agreement is a自然语言制品natural-language artefact：对科学主张的裁决， 分类建议、高级计划。此类文物有 不是经典拜占庭错误的字节相同值 宽容（BFT）视为理所当然。两个诚实的代理人询问了 同样的问题，给出同样的证据，并用同样的提示 配置文件，将定期发出文本上不同的字符串，其: a verdict on a scientific claim, a triage recommendation, a high-level plan. Such artefacts are not the byte-identical values that classical Byzantine fault tolerance (BFT) takes for granted. Two honest agents asked the same question, given the same evidence, and prompted with the same profile, will routinely emit textually distinct strings whose语义内容semantic content是一样的。一个协议需要 因此，必须在这一轮中承诺一个“答案” 作为语义对象的提案，而不是字节。is the same. A protocol that needs to commit to one “answer” for the round must therefore reason about proposals as semantic objects, not as bytes.

经典 BFT 协议（PBFTClassical BFT protocols (PBFT(Castro and Liskov, 1999), 热点, HotStuff(Yin et al., 2019)和后继者）提供 离散值的确定性最终性：法定人数, and successors) provide deterministic finality for discrete values: a quorum of2​f+12f{+}1 独特的distinct单个字节字符串上的签名者，其下signers on a single byte-string, which under|ℬ|≤f|\mathcal{B}|\leq f至少包含contains at leastf+1f{+}1诚实的签名，是 足够了。最近的工作 关于多代理LLM投票和辩论 提供双重极端honest signatures, is sufficient. Recent work on multi-agent LLM voting and debate offers the dual extreme(Du et al., 2023; Liang et al., 2023; Chen et al., 2024): 软聚合步骤（多数判决、置信度加权 判决，或一位博学的法官）没有证书，不能中止 行为，并且聚合和之间没有正式的联系 底层语义内容。两个极端都不足以满足 LLM代理系统，下游消费者需要 验证者可检查句柄打开: a soft aggregation step (majority verdict, confidence-weighted verdict, or a learned judge) with no certificate, no abort behaviour, and no formal connection between the aggregation and the underlying semantic content. Neither extreme is adequate for LLM-agent systems where downstream consumers need a verifier-checkable handle on其中which已做出判决 下verdict was committed under其中which参数由parameters by其中which签名者集，以及 其中拜占庭部分的代理可能会产生看似合理但 语义中毒的提案signer set, and where a Byzantine fraction of the agents may produce plausible but semantically poisoned proposals(Datta et al., 2025; Ferrag et al., 2026).

拜占庭语义中毒是一种真正的失败模式。Byzantine semantic poisoning is a real failure mode.

拜占庭法学硕士代理人不需要“崩溃”；它可以 只需提示提出流畅的提案， 切中主题，在传达信息时词汇上接近诚实的大众 相反的判决。文本攻击文献由来已久 表明小的、语义上有意义的扰动 流畅的文字可以翻转下游 分类器A Byzantine LLM agent does not need to be “broken”; it can simply be prompted to produce proposals that are fluent, on-topic, and lexically close to the honest mass while conveying the opposite verdict. The textual-attack literature has long shown that small, semantically meaningful perturbations of fluent text can flip a downstream classifier(Jin et al., 2020; Alzantot et al., 2018; Li et al., 2020), 和即时注射研究也显示出同样的现象 跨代理传播 法学硕士工作流程, and prompt-injection studies show the same phenomenon propagates across agentic LLM workflows(Lee and Tiwari, 2024; Datta et al., 2025)。 我们在下面凭经验表明. We empirically show below that a冲rushing拜占庭式（观察诚实代理人的行为的一种 在提交自己的广播之前）可以瞄准留下的空白 由诚实的群众完成我们 50 项任务的每一轮 真实代理基准，以及事实上的朴素基准， 置信加权投票，然后做出如下判决： 不同意诚实群众的观点Byzantine (one that observes the honest agents’ broadcasts before submitting its own) can target the gap left by the honest mass on every single round of our 50-task real-agent benchmark, and that the de-facto naive baseline, confidence-weighted voting, then commits a verdict that disagrees with the honest mass on12%12\%轮次。of rounds.

It does not consult honest, gold, evidence- truth, source-reliability, or external-judge signals. 方法。Approach.

我们建议We propose分层认证的语义承诺Hierarchical Certified Semantic Commitment（H-CSC），一种运行在 交付了一组结构化代理提案并生成了 输入提交对象。每个代理提交一份提案，其中包含 规范判决字段、置信度值、证据 ID 清单、理由和声明文本。该协议是一个 四级管道加上类型化决策步骤： (1) 每个提案规范文本的确定性编码 进入单位规范语义嵌入； (2) 按判决分组并选择候选判决 组(H-CSC), a finality-control protocol that operates on a delivered set of structured agent proposals and produces a typed commit object. Each agent submits a proposal with a canonical verdict field, a confidence value, an evidence-id list, a rationale, and a claim text. The protocol is a four-stage pipeline plus a typed-decision step: (1) deterministic encoding of each proposal’s canonical text into a unit-norm semantic embedding; (2) grouping by verdict and selection of a candidate verdict groupGv⋆G_{v^{\star}}; (3) 提取可接受的; (3) extraction of an admissible判决内within-verdict语义 核心（一个semantic core (a2​f+12f{+}1的子集subset ofGv⋆G_{v^{\star}}谁的嵌入 坐在半径为角的球内whose embeddings sit inside an angular ball of radiusθα\theta_{\alpha}）； (4)稳健的几何中位数 聚合); (4) robust geometric-median aggregation(Pillutla et al., 2022; Mendes and Herlihy, 2013; Blanchard et al., 2017), 晶格量化和参数绑定摘要。类型决定 步骤然后产生三个结果之一：, lattice quantisation, and parameter-bound digest. The typed-decision step then produces one of three outcomes: a语义提交semantic_commit（判决内语义核心是 可接受并且协议发出(the within-verdict semantic core is admissible and the protocol emits a2​f+12f{+}1证书结束 嵌入支持的摘要），certificate over the embedding-backed digest), a判决提交verdict_commit（该 候选人判决组有一个(the candidate verdict group has a2​f+12f{+}1法定人数和余量 至少有一名超过亚军，并且协议发出quorum and a margin of at least one over the runner-up, and the protocol emits a2​f+12f{+}1证明仅判决摘要，没有 语义聚合），或显式certificate over a verdict-only digest with no semantic aggregate), or an explicit中止abort带有打字的 原因（节with a typed reason (Section5).

分层类型提交形状是关键的概念移动。 二进制提交或中止框架强制协议中止 每当嵌入集群跨越完整交付的视图时 过于分散，无法接纳单一的The hierarchical typed-commit shape is the key conceptual move. A binary commit-or-abort framing forces the protocol to abort whenever the embedding cluster across the full delivered view is too dispersed to admit a single2​f+12f{+}1语义核心， 即使基本判决相差很大。 H-CSC 相反，认识到判决和嵌入几何 是两个不同的最终信号。当两者都可以接受时， 该协议承诺嵌入支持的来源 （semantic core, even when the underlying verdicts agree by a wide margin. H-CSC instead recognises that the verdict and the embedding geometry are two distinct finality signals. When both are admissible, the protocol commits with embedding-backed provenance (语义提交semantic_commit）；当只有判决法定人数时 可接受，协议提交仅判决摘要 （); when only the verdict quorum is admissible, the protocol commits with a verdict-only digest (判决提交verdict_commit）；当两者均不可接受时， 协议中止。这三个结果中的每一个都经过认证 一样的); when neither is admissible, the protocol aborts. Each of the three outcomes is certified under the same2​f+12f{+}1独特签名者信封；仅底层 消化变化。该协议从不提交没有摘要的摘要 仲裁证书，并且永远不会在以下情况下声明语义聚合： 判决内的语义核心是不可接受的。 H-CSC 是 因此不是多数投票：投票选择答案； H-CSC 证明系统合理的最终确定性水平 索赔。distinct-signer envelope; only the underlying digest changes. The protocol never commits a digest without a quorum certificate, and never claims a semantic aggregate when the within-verdict semantic core is not admissible. H-CSC is therefore not majority vote: a vote selects an answer; H-CSC certifies the level of finality the system is justified to claim.

2. 相关工作Related Work

我们的工作处于新兴的制度中，异构的法学硕士代理人在开放的环境中进行协作，但系统必须致力于单一的、可审计的结果。先前工作的最接近的线程解决了（i）多代理LLM协作和答案聚合，（ii）代理多LLM工作流程中的安全威胁，以及（iii）超越字节相同值的拜占庭协议/鲁棒聚合。我们通过仍然缺失的内容来回顾它们Our work is situated in the emerging regime where heterogeneous LLM agents collaborate in open environments, and the system must nevertheless commit to a single, auditable outcome. The closest threads of prior work address (i) multi-agent LLM collaboration and answer aggregation, (ii) security threats in agentic multi-LLM workflows, and (iii) Byzantine agreement / robust aggregation beyond byte-identical values. We review them through the lens of what remains missing for协议级语义提交protocol-grade semantic commit.

多代理 LLM 协作和聚合。Multi-agent LLM collaboration and aggregation.

越来越多的工作研究多主体 LLM 协作（例如辩论、审议和委员会式工作流程）作为提高任务绩效和可靠性的机制A growing body of work studies multi-agent LLM collaboration (e.g., debate, deliberation, and committee-style workflows) as a mechanism to improve task performance and reliability(Park et al., 2023; Li et al., 2024; Du et al., 2023; Liang et al., 2023)。 在实践中，这些系统经常通过投票或合并来合并多个随机输出，以产生单个答案。 最近的评估框架明确对许多法学硕士判决采用多数投票/汇总，强调了汇总的普遍性和法学硕士非决定论的操作影响. In practice, these systems frequently consolidate multiple stochastic outputs via voting or pooling to produce a single answer. Recent evaluation frameworks explicitly adopt majority vote / pooling over many LLM judgments, highlighting both the prevalence of aggregation and the operational impact of LLM non-determinism(Zhao et al., 2025)。 与此同时，一系列工作研究了原则性聚合规则，用于组合多个法学硕士输出，超越简单多数投票，通常优化法官可靠性统计模型下的预期准确性. Concurrently, a line of work studies principled aggregation rules for combining multiple LLM outputs beyond naive majority voting, typically optimizing expected accuracy under statistical models of judge reliability(Ai et al., 2025)。 然而，这些努力并不是被设计为分布式共识协议：它们通常假设有一个值得信赖的协调者或良性参与者，并且不为在开放网络中提交单个结果提供拜占庭安全/活跃风格的保证。. These efforts, however, are not designed as distributed consensus protocols: they generally assume a trusted coordinator or benign participants and do not provide Byzantine safety/liveness-style guarantees for committing a single outcome in an open network.

代理多法学硕士系统中的威胁。Threats in agentic multi-LLM systems.

随着法学硕士合作变得代理化和工具集成化，对抗性参与成为首要问题。 最近的研究表明，及时注射可以传播As LLM collaboration becomes agentic and tool-integrated, adversarial participation becomes a first-order concern. Recent studies demonstrate that prompt injection can propagate跨越across互连代理（LLM 到 LLM 感染），实现多代理工作流程的持续妥协interconnected agents (LLM-to-LLM infection), enabling persistent compromise of a multi-agent workflow(Lee and Tiwari, 2024)。 调查和系统化进一步对 LLM 代理生态系统中的威胁进行分类，包括跨代理注入和协议层漏洞，并主张在部署的代理系统中进行分层防御和验证. Surveys and systematizations further categorize threats in LLM-agent ecosystems, including cross-agent injection and protocol-layer vulnerabilities, and argue for layered defenses and verification in deployed agentic systems(Ferrag et al., 2026; Datta et al., 2025)。 这些工作激发了对在对抗性制作的语义工件下保持正确的协议机制的需求；然而，它们专注于代理/工作流级别的攻击面和缓解措施，而不是提供在拜占庭错误下确定性地致力于单一语义结果的共识原语。. These works motivate the need for protocol mechanisms that remain correct under adversarially crafted semantic artifacts; however, they focus on attack surfaces and mitigations at the agent/workflow level, rather than providing a consensus primitive that deterministically commits to a single semantic outcome under Byzantine faults.

拜占庭协议和强大的聚合超越了精确的平等。Byzantine agreement and robust aggregation beyond exact equality.

经典的 BFT 协议（例如 PBFT、HotStuff）提供了字节相同值的安全性和活性，而诸如近似协议之类的放宽协议则解决了不同的数值向量。 在分布式学习中，最近的工作强调鲁棒聚合必须与协议子例程相结合，并重新审视拜占庭行为下基于几何中值的聚合的多维近似协议Classical BFT protocols (e.g., PBFT, HotStuff) provide safety and liveness over byte-identical values, while relaxations such as approximate agreement address non-identical numeric vectors. In distributed learning, recent work emphasizes that robust aggregation must be coupled with an agreement subroutine, and revisits multidimensional approximate agreement for geometric-median-based aggregation under Byzantine behavior(Milentijević et al., 2025)。 另外，初步尝试已开始将 BFT 式机制与多 LLM 协作联系起来，例如，为多 LLM 网络提出区块链驱动的加权 BFT 投票. Separately, initial attempts have begun to connect BFT-style mechanisms with multi-LLM collaboration, e.g., proposing blockchain-driven weighted BFT voting for multi-LLM networks(Luo et al., 2025)。 更广泛地说，人们已经探索了受共识启发的公式，以提高通信攻击下通信多智能体系统的鲁棒性. More broadly, consensus-inspired formulations have been explored for robustness in communicative multi-agent systems under communication attacks(Mao et al., 2024)。 然而，这些指示并没有解决具体问题 障碍中心. Nevertheless, these directions do not address the specific obstacle central to语义提交semantic commit：LLM代理轮次 提供随机自然语言提案和协议 必须决定: an LLM-agent round delivers stochastic natural-language proposals, and the protocol must decide什么样的what kind本轮支持的最终性 而不是总是做出一个判决。 H-CSC 的不同之处在于引入了of finality the round supports rather than always producing one verdict. H-CSC differs by introducing a类型化提交对象typed commit object (语义提交semantic_commit / 判决提交verdict_commit / 中止abort）： 每个类型的结果都具有相同的): each typed outcome carries the same2​f+12f{+}1证书信封 但绑定到不同的底层摘要，因此验证者可以 区分嵌入支持的协议和仅判决的协议 协议和类型安全中止。早期的配方 这项工作探索了基于拓扑的过滤作为中心 机制；我们现在报告说，探索 附录certificate envelope but binds to a different underlying digest, so verifiers can distinguish embedding-backed agreements from verdict-only agreements and from typed safe aborts. Earlier formulations of this work explored topology-based filtering as the central mechanism; we now report that exploration in AppendixC作为设计空间的消融 只是因为在它产生的每个测量基准上 提交/中止决策与 H-CSC 主路径相同 或者严格保守而不改进 诚实参考效度。as a design-space ablation only, because on every measured benchmark it produces commit/abort decisions either identical to the H-CSC main path or strictly more conservative without improving honest-reference validity.

This bound is both necessary and sufficient: with fewer than3​f+13f+1节点，对手控制nodes, an adversary controllingff拜占庭节点可以将诚实节点分为两组，这两组都提交了冲突的值，从而违反了安全性Byzantine nodes can partition honest nodes into two groups that commit conflicting values, violating safety(Lamport et al., 1982)。的. The3​f+13f+1自从 Lamport 等人对拜占庭将军问题的开创性工作以来，阈值一直是基础性的threshold has been foundational since Lamport et al.’s seminal work on the Byzantine Generals Problem(Lamport et al., 1982)并保留部分同步下需要精确一致的协议的标准容错限制and remains the standard fault tolerance limit for protocols requiring exact agreement under partial synchrony(Dwork et al., 1988).

我们认为拜占庭对手控制着一组错误的 节点We consider a Byzantine adversary that controls the set of faulty nodesℬ\mathcal{B}与with|ℬ|≤f|\mathcal{B}|\leq f。我们评估 两种对抗模式下的协议：. We evaluate the protocol under two adversary modes:静态的static，其中生成拜占庭提交 独立于同一轮中的诚实广播，并且, where Byzantine submissions are generated independently of the honest broadcasts in the same round, and冲rushing，拜占庭人在其中读取回合的诚实信息 提交前先播（以网络情况为准） 下面的加密约束）。匆忙是最坏的情况 供我们分析；两种模式都配对进行评估 部分, where the Byzantine reads the round’s honest broadcasts before submitting (subject to the network and cryptographic constraints below). Rushing is the strict worst case for our analysis; both modes are evaluated paired in Section6。语义中毒能力 在定义中形式化. The semantic-poisoning capability formalised in Definition3.8是 与计时模式无关。is independent of the timing mode.

能力。Capabilities.

拜占庭节点可能任意偏离协议，包括选择任意文本Byzantine nodes may deviate arbitrarily from the protocol, including choosing arbitrary textsxb∈𝒳x_{b}\in\mathcal{X}并在损坏的节点之间进行协调。 我们专注于and coordinating across corrupted nodes. We focus on语义中毒semantic poisoning行为，其中对手精心设计的输入旨在扭曲集体承诺的含义，同时保持嵌入接近诚实的输入（即，难以单独使用几何进行过滤）。behavior, where the adversary crafts inputs that are intended to distort the collectively committed meaning while remaining embedding-proximal to honest inputs (i.e., difficult to filter using geometry alone).

加密和通信限制。Cryptographic and communication constraints.

节点通过经过身份验证的点对点通道进行通信，并且签名是不可伪造的。 RBC 用于传播回合输入。 RBC 不会阻止拜占庭发送者尝试模棱两可，但它保证诚实节点不会最终收到来自同一发送者（协议）的冲突交付值，也只能是诚实节点的严格子集从该发送者传递值（总体/统一交付）。 因此，任何成功的回合都源于一致的交付观点。Nodes communicate over authenticated point-to-point channels and signatures are unforgeable. RBC is used for disseminating round inputs. RBC does not prevent Byzantine senders from attempting equivocation, but it guarantees that honest nodes cannot end up with conflicting delivered values from the same sender (Agreement), nor can only a strict subset of honest nodes deliver a value from that sender (Totality/Uniform delivery). Thus, any successful round proceeds from a consistent delivered view.

5. 正确性分析Correctness Analysis

我们将正确性分为五个轴：We split correctness into five axes:协议Agreement, 语义有效性Semantic validity, 判决有效性Verdict validity, 安全中止Safe abort, 和, and有条件的提交或中止 终止Conditional commit-or-abort termination。分裂反映了协议/有效性/ 古典拜占庭的终止分解标准 协议. The split mirrors the agreement / validity / termination decomposition standard in classical Byzantine agreement(Lamport et al., 1982; Castro and Liskov, 1999; Dolev et al., 1986; Yin et al., 2019), 带有附加的安全中止和类型化有效性轴 的分层提交对象 定义, with the additional safe-abort and typed-validity axes that the hierarchical commit object of Definition3.3需要。的requires. The语义提交semantic_commit和and判决提交verdict_commit结果 承认诚实参考的明显充分条件 有效性，并且终止保证现在是析取的 三种类型的结果而不是二进制结果 提交/中止声明。outcomes admit distinct sufficient conditions for honest-reference validity, and the termination guarantee is now a disjunction over the three typed outcomes rather than a binary commit/abort claim.

MVR-50 (§6.2）是一个) is a真实的realLLM-代理 Climate-FEVER 的声明验证基准（已记录的 SciFact 的后备），提案在静态和静态之间配对 急速的拜占庭攻击模式。 §LLM-agent claim-verification benchmark on Climate-FEVER (a documented fallback for SciFact), with proposals paired across static and rushing Byzantine attack modes. §6.4报告覆盖恢复情况 H-CSC与严格语义配置的比较 属于同一框架。 §reports the coverage-recovery comparison between H-CSC and the strict-semantic configuration of the same framework. §6.5报告了reports the语义提交semantic_commit / 判决提交verdict_commit分裂，即 嵌入轴的贡献。 §split, which is the contribution attributable to the embedding axis. §6.6报告阈值和回退 敏感性； §reports threshold and fallback sensitivity; §6.7报告拓扑 设计空间消融。reports the topology design-space ablation.必须报告这两个基准； 两者都不能替代对方Both benchmarks must be reported; neither replaces the other：BCS_v1 隔离编码器行为 针对我们完全控制的攻击分布，而 MVR-50 根据随机 LLM 提案衡量协议行为。: BCS_v1 isolates encoder behaviour against an attack distribution we fully control, while MVR-50 measures protocol behaviour against stochastic LLM proposals.

6.1. BCS_v1 上的受控语义中毒基准Controlled Semantic-Poisoning Benchmark on BCS_v1

目的和范围。Purpose and scope.

BCS_v1 是受控诊断，BCS_v1 is a controlled diagnostic,不not真实代理人 基准。诚实的建议是相同的释义 维基百科主播；拜占庭提案由 GPT 生成 语义 毒药a real-agent benchmark. Honest proposals are paraphrases of the same Wikipedia anchor; Byzantine proposals are curated GPT-generated semantic poisons(Jin et al., 2020; Alzantot et al., 2018; Morris et al., 2020)以主播的判决为目标。我们使用 BCS_v1 验证 (a) 编码器可分离性 完全控制的攻击分布，以及（b）协议的 超越拜占庭容错 (Beyond BFT) 制度中的行为that target the anchor’s verdict. We use BCS_v1 to validate (a) encoder separability under a fully-controlled attack distribution, and (b) the protocol’s behaviour in the beyond-BFT regime wheren<3​f+1n<3f{+}1。 BCS_v1 确实 不验证真正的异构LLM-代理协作；那就是 MVR-50的作用如下。. 与多主体辩论/聚合的区别。Distinction from multi-agent debate / aggregation.

最接近的法学硕士方面的先验是多代理辩论和 聚合The closest LLM-side prior is multi-agent debate and aggregation(Du et al., 2023; Liang et al., 2023; Chen et al., 2024; Ai et al., 2025), 通过软聚合结合随机 LLM 输出 或习得的判断机制。 这些作品都没有针对拜占庭容忍的提交 原语：它们假设一个良性协调器，不发出, which combines stochastic LLM outputs through soft-aggregation or learned-judge mechanisms. None of these works targets a Byzantine-tolerant commit primitive: they assume a benign coordinator, do not emit a2​f+12f{+}1证书，不提供安全中止分支 圆太分散，没有将底层分开 从表面的判决来看，答案的最终性。 H-CSC 的类型 提交对象变成“代理群体同意吗？”从一个 将问题软聚合为类型化、可验证者检查的问题 最终决定。certificate, do not provide a safe-abort branch when the round is too dispersed, and do not separate the underlying finality of an answer from its surface verdict. H-CSC’s typed commit object turns “does the agent crowd agree?” from a soft-aggregation question into a typed, verifier-checkable finality decision.

Within-round vendor heterogeneity (e.g., mixing OpenAI and Anthropic agents in the same round) and encoder-class generalisation are explicit follow-ups; the schema and protocol both already accept heterogeneous agent populations, so this is an experiment-pipeline limitation rather than a protocol limitation.

5. 两种有效性概念可能存在分歧。5. Two validity notions can diverge.

定义Definition3.7分离数据集-gold 来自证据有限的诚实参考有效性的有效性（separates dataset-gold validity from evidence-bounded honest-reference validity (the无效_hmajinvalid_hmajmetric 保留其基准工具名称 但“hmaj”表示具有确定性的诚实复数 抢七局，非严格多数；看到 定义metric retains its bench-tooling name but “hmaj” denotes the honest plurality with deterministic tie-break, not strict majority; see Definition3.7）。两者每当出现分歧时 诚实的多数裁决无法与给出的黄金标签相匹配 只有看得见的证据。协议无法举行 负责由数据集标签噪声驱动的分歧。我们 不声称也不会声称黄金有效性数字 表征协议的正确性。). The two diverge whenever the honest plurality verdict cannot match the gold label given only the visible evidence. The protocol cannot be held responsible for divergences driven by dataset label noise. We do not claim, and will not claim, that gold-validity numbers characterise protocol correctness.

6. 表示边界 （引理6. Representation boundary (Lemma5.8).

如果两个提案嵌入到编码器中的相同点 表示，协议无法在任何方面区分它们 嵌入的功能，包括可接受性 谓词。这种情况下的防御不是嵌入 过滤但安全中止分支。根据经验，这表现为 B4（主题幻觉）案例，其中拜占庭细节是 捏造的，但在词汇和语义上接近诚实 输出；在 MVR-50 任务的子集上，诚实集群是 可接受的边界线If two proposals embed to identical points in the encoder’s representation, the protocol cannot distinguish them on any function of the embeddings, including the admissibility predicate. The defence in such cases is not the embedding filter but the safe-abort branch. Empirically this manifests as B4 (on-topic hallucination) cases where Byzantine specifics are fabricated but lexically and semantically close to honest output; on a subset of MVR-50 tasks the honest cluster is borderline-admissible atθα=0.55\theta_{\alpha}=0.55和协议 中止而不是进行中毒消化。and the protocol aborts rather than committing a poisoned digest.

9. 逻辑证书，而不是门限签名密码学。9. Logical certificate, not threshold-signature cryptography.

该实现使用逻辑签名模拟器 保留每个签名者的唯一性和The implementation uses a logical signature simulator that preserves per-signer uniqueness and the2​f+12f{+}1独特的签名者 阈值。生产阈值签名方案（例如 BLS、 FROST、阈值 ECDSA）是标准替代。我们做distinct-signer threshold. Production threshold-signature schemes (e.g. BLS, FROST, threshold ECDSA) are a standard substitution. We do不not实施、评估或分析密码学 基元； § 的担保主张implement, evaluate, or analyse cryptographic primitives; the security claim of §5是 关于协议的逻辑结构，而不是它的 加密实例化。is about the protocol’s logical structure, not about its cryptographic instantiation.

超出范围。Out-of-scope.

我们不使用模型权重来应对白盒对手 准入、跨任务合谋、多轮审议 代理迭代彼此建议的协议，或者 经认证的承诺的协议级减少对象 下游消费者。这些都是未来明确的工作。We do not address white-box adversaries with model-weight access, cross-task collusion, multi-round deliberation protocols where agents iterate on each other’s proposals, or protocol-level reductions of the certified commitment object to downstream consumers. These are explicit future work.

8. 结论Conclusion

我们介绍了We introduced分层认证的语义承诺Hierarchical Certified Semantic Commitment(H-CSC)，拜占庭弹性的最终控制协议 LLM-代理合作。而不是折叠每轮 决策到单个提交/中止轴，H-CSC 产生一个 输入的提交对象：a(H-CSC), a finality-control protocol for Byzantine-resilient LLM-agent collaboration. 引理的证明The proof of Lemma5.8给出 部分given in Section5是直接的（两个提案 相同的嵌入不能通过任何函数来区分 嵌入）并且不需要额外的细节。我们 这里只包括一个将引理连接到 经验性 B4（主题幻觉）失败模式报告于 部分is direct (two proposals with identical embeddings cannot be distinguished by any function of the embeddings) and does not require additional details. We include here only an extension that connects the lemma to the empirical B4 (on-topic-hallucination) failure mode reported in Sections6.2和and6.7.

如果拜占庭提案If a Byzantine proposalρb\rho_{b}被设计成这样is engineered so that∠​(ℰ​(ρh),ℰ​(ρb))\angle(\mathcal{E}(\rho_{h}),\mathcal{E}(\rho_{b}))小但非零，则 可采性谓词可以承认is small but nonzero, the admissibility predicate may either admitρb\rho_{b}到 选定的核心（第 2 阶段 算法to the selected core (Stage 2 of Algorithm1）或按 舍入谓词的阈值和触发器) or push the round across the predicate’s threshold and triggerabort​(admissibility_failed)\textsc{abort}(\texttt{admissibility\_failed})。在实证中 MVR-50评测，后者结果占主导：拜占庭 接近诚实集群边界的嵌入产生. In the empirical MVR-50 evaluation, the latter outcome dominates: Byzantine embeddings that approach an honest cluster’s boundary produce中止abort，不提交。在这种情况下的辩护是 类型化安全中止分支与更严格的编码器相结合，而不是 嵌入过滤器本身。加强代表性 质量（更好的编码器培训、超越内容感知的功能 因此，嵌入）是未来的自然轴 改善。, not commit. The defence in such cases is the typed safe-abort branch combined with a tighter encoder, not the embedding filter itself. Strengthening representation quality (better encoder training, content-aware features beyond the embedding) is therefore the natural axis of future improvement.

C.4. 本附录不是什么What this appendix is not

这个附录是This appendix is不not竞争性的主路径提案。 确实如此a competing main-path proposal. It does不not支持“拓扑是 必要的”、“拓扑提高了准确性”或“拓扑是一个 安全门可以捕获角度过滤器遗漏的内容”。 修正的结果是相反的：在选择的操作 点，拓扑门与主拓扑门是决策冗余的 路径；在操作点之外，它将提交率换为 额外的中止不会提高诚实参考的有效性。我们 为了透明度起见，请在此处报告设计空间消融；的 修正决策的基本原理记录在作者的 内部决策日志，计划伴随未来 再现性包。support claims of the form “topology is necessary”, “topology improves accuracy”, or “topology is a safety gate that catches what the angular filter misses”. The corrected finding is the opposite: at the chosen operating point, the topology gate is decision-redundant with the main path; outside the operating point, it trades commit rate for extra aborts without improving honest-reference validity. We report the design-space ablation here for transparency; the corrected-decision rationale is recorded in the authors’ internal decision log, which is planned to accompany a future reproducibility package.
